title: net10.0-windows consumes net9.0-windows and net9.0 assets

probe.result: Build succeeded. 0 Warning(s) 0 Error(s) on the incremental build

findings: The reference resolves; no NU1201 and no NETSDK1138.
BeepControlStyle lives in TheTechIdea.Beep.WPF.Controls.Styling, not the root namespace.
A clean build of the reference chain raises 9278 CA1416 warnings from TheTechIdea.Beep.Vis.Modules (WinForms theme code), not from our code.
decision: Accepted — net10.0-windows for WPF projects, net10.0 for Core and Data.
requiredFollowUp: Set NoWarn=CA1416 only on the project that references the controls library, with a comment naming the owner, before FND-04 wires BeepChrome. Keep CA1416 enabled everywhere else.
limits: The probe compiles a type reference; it does not instantiate a control or apply a skin at runtime.
The 9278-warning count comes from a clean build of the sibling project on this machine; it may differ with another SDK.
